item.title: fix(gateway): surface cloud workspace recovery failures (#128864)
item.summary:
fix(gateway): surface cloud workspace recovery failures (#128864) * fix(gateway): record workspace recovery failures Persist bounded, deduplicated recovery-attempt failures through the session transcript while preserving pending workspace result fences, and prefer current recovery errors over stale terminal reasons.

Refs #128850 * fix(gateway): revalidate recovery transcript ownership Recheck the canonical session mapping inside the queued transcript transaction so a rebound session cannot receive a stale workspace recovery diagnostic.

Refs #128850
